releases.name: Markitect v0.14.1
releases.notes:
Markitect 0.14.1 preserves the published Project/Domain CLI and bundles an experimental canonical projection/controller preview.

- The canonical alpha supports Schema/Definition intent, Schema and Projection Modules, explicitly bound execution, guarded materialization, fresh Verify and declared-scope Audit. Saved Apply-result handoff belongs to this alpha.
- Temporary Git test fixtures disable automatic detached maintenance/GC. Linux CI repeats the existing cleanup regression 100 times without relaxing assertions or timeouts.
- This is a bounded CLI and evidence workflow. Continuous autonomous operation, whole-repository semantic assurance and reduced human supervision remain unproven.

Source: [7dbd599c81540c8203a1b7f83afbc335174f4f1f](https://github.com/Glacius-Labs/Markitect/commit/7dbd599c81540c8203a1b7f83afbc335174f4f1f). [Windows/Linux release and installation gates](https://github.com/Glacius-Labs/Markitect/actions/runs/37624704624) passed on attempt 1. The immutable release and all four asset attestations were verified; anonymous download hashes and native Windows/Linux version outputs matched.

The original v0.14.0 tag remains unchanged and unpublished after two recorded [fixture-cleanup failures](https://github.com/Glacius-Labs/Markitect/actions/runs/37619287880). The original writer was not identified.

See the [README](https://github.com/Glacius-Labs/Markitect#readme), [alpha guide](https://github.com/Glacius-Labs/Markitect/blob/main/docs/canonical-projections.md) and [production assessment](https://github.com/Glacius-Labs/Markitect/blob/main/docs/production-assessment.md) for installation, scope and evidence. Government-specific redesign is outside this release.
